claims.text: OBJ passed to the thunk as ARG2 is LEA ECX,[ESP+0x18] at 0048EDE8, i.e. a stack local of the 0048EDxx frame; ESI (ARG1) is the reader object used throughout (byte [ESI+0x11] flag tests).
OBJ is constructed in place at [ESP+0x18] by CALL 0085BBE0 (0048EDDF) immediately before the thunk call; callee body not opened.

OBJ is NOT R: R=M32[B+0xC] is a persistent owner field value; OBJ is a fresh stack temporary of a stream loader. The 0085BD80 store+2C is therefore NOT the R-to-P provider writer (scoped negative for this chain).
